analysis:
This batch contains only two new test files: provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomCLITests/ClusterWaitlistGateTests.swift (head lines 1-172) and FeatureWaitlistTests.swift (head 1-721). Unit 6e04efa3e168f2c2:0 is metadata only. The tests describe new CLI behavior whose implementation is not in this batch: a `darkbloom waitlist` command, FeatureWaitlistClient and a waitlist gate before `cluster` setup and `sandbox setup`.

Security-relevant contracts these tests assert, to be verified against the implementation:
- The bearer login token is sent only to an https coordinator or to loopback (FeatureWaitlistTests base() test, patch lines ~178-187). This relates to A-008 token exposure.
- Coordinator-supplied title, summary and start_command text is sanitized of control, format and bidi characters before reaching the terminal. --json output escapes them (printableText and inertListCommand). This covers terminal-injection risk from adversarial or MITM coordinator text.
- start_command is displayed, never executed.
- The sandbox gate stops before any probe or download when the account is waitlisted, revoked or unauthenticated (gateRefuses asserts 0 requests). This affects TB-013/T-061 ordering.

The gate is a client-side UX check and fails open on a 404 (`notOffered`, which means "going on"). It must not be treated as an authorization control: an operator (ADV-001) can bypass it trivially. Coordinator-side enforcement of cluster and sandbox access is platform-owned and not evidenced here.

`cluster local` and already-paired Macs are never gated. This is consistent with the tests and adds no new privileged surface (TB-014 unaffected).

No regression is identifiable from test-only changes. Integration should verify:
- FeatureWaitlistClient.base rejects http to non-loopback hosts and handles redirects so the token is not forwarded.
- Sanitization is applied to every coordinator string, including error messages.
- The sandbox installer download (T-061) still follows the gate and is unchanged.
- The threat model notes that the waitlist gate is advisory, not authorization.
